name: Meal Prep Sunday
notes: This is a weekly meal-prep subscription service, not a plated restaurant menu - dishes are sold by subscription plan rather than individually priced. Own site shows a rotating weekly lineup of 15 meals (5 breakfast, 5 lunch, 5 dinner) and REGULAR (non-promotional) per-meal pricing by plan size: 5-meal plan = $13.58/meal ($67.90 total), 10-meal and 15-meal plans = $12.99/meal. First-order promotional prices (as low as $3.38/meal) exist but are not the standing price and are excluded per the rule against marketplace/promo pricing. Price field below uses the 10/15-meal plan rate ($12.99), the more common tier, and notes the 5-meal plan rate. This IS the whole current rotating menu (15 meals is their full weekly lineup, not a subset), though the specific 15 meals rotate week to week.
